title: JSON & CSV Bench
description: Format, validate, minify, and convert JSON and CSV locally. Repair trailing commas, sort keys, and jump to the first error. All core features are free.

title: Todo Digest
description: Find TODO, FIXME, HACK, and NOTE comments, jump to each one, and export Markdown, CSV, or JSON. All core features are free.

title: Env Guard: Compare & Validate .env
description: Compare .env files with .env.example, catch missing, extra, and duplicate keys, sort keys, and optionally mask values. Runs entirely locally. All core features are free.

title: Phem
description: Syntax highlighting, and the Phem language server for .phem files: diagnostics as you type, completion, go to definition, find references with usage counts, hover, and outline.

title: Livebuf
description: Edit the same files together in VS Code and Cursor. People who can see the GitHub repository join automatically. Connected agents coordinate overlapping changes for both people to accept.

title: Papastro - Language, Syntax & File Icons

title: Abyss Theme for VS Code
